summary: Research each DJI drone real-world shape features + verified dimensions to guide accurate v2 parametric CAD

result.body_shape: 매끈한 유선형 elongated 쿼드콥터(4로터) 바디. 리뷰들이 "잠자리(dragonfly)/상어 머리" 실루엣으로 묘사 — 전면의 큰 구형 짐벌이 스트림라인 동체에 붙은 '머리'처럼 보임. 전형적 Mavic 접이식 형태를 유지하되 이전 세대보다 부피가 크고(무게 1kg 초과, EU C2 등급) 각진 느낌이 줄어든 더 둥근/매끈한 프로파일. 펼쳤을 때 폭(390.5mm)이 길이(328.7mm)보다 커서 암이 좌우로 넓게 벌어지는 넓은 스탠스.
result.gimbal: 전면(nose)에 위치한 near-spherical "Infinity Gimbal" — 공(ball) 모양으로 동체에 매끈하게 파묻혀 '떠 있는 눈'처럼 보임. 종전의 아래로 매달린 짐벌 방식이 아니라 전면 통합형. 렌즈 3개(트리플 카메라): 큰 메인 Hasselblad(28mm, 4/3" 100MP, 가변조리개) + 중간 텔레(70mm, 1/1.3" 48MP) + 텔레(168mm, 1/1.5" 50MP). 롤축 360° 완전 회전 + 위로 70° 틸트 가능. 3렌즈가 짐벌 구체 전면에 배열되며 메인 렌즈가 가장 크고 두 텔레가 작음.
result.arms: 4개 접이식 슬림 암(쿼드콥터). 재설계된 접이 구조로 암과 다리가 서로 간섭하지 않음. Mavic 관례상 전방 2암은 앞으로, 후방 2암은 뒤로 펼쳐짐. 동체와 같은 미드/다크 그레이. 후방 암이 착륙 지지 역할 겸함. 정확한 암 두께·배치각 수치는 1차 출처에서 확인 못함(카본 아님, 플라스틱/그레이 도색).
result.landing_gear: 별도의 긴 다리는 없음 — 접이식 후방 암 하부에 작은 착륙 발(landing feet)이 통합됨. 동체 하부(base)에 착륙 발과 어안 렌즈 보호용 작은 프로텍터, 격자(grille)형 질감 마감. Phantom식 아치 다리나 Matrice식 긴 착륙 스키드 없음.
result.propeller: 접이식 quick-release 프로펠러(누르고 돌려 장착). Mavic 관례상 2날(2-blade) 형태로 추정. 색상은 동체와 유사한 그레이/블랙, 팁 별도 색 표기 없음. Mavic 4 Pro 전용 프롭(부품 CP.MA.00000844.01). 정확한 지름/모델번호(9453 여부)는 1차 출처로 확정 못함 — 웹 검색이 Mavic 3의 9453(지름 23.9cm)과 혼동됨.
result.top_features: 상단에 안테나 마스트나 RTK 돔 없음(소비자형). 상단은 매끈하며 전방향 비전 시스템용 어안 렌즈 3개가 위쪽에 배치(하단에도 3개, 총 6개). 상단 GPS는 내장.
result.color: 미드~다크 그레이(회색) 단색 airframe, 무광 계열. 여행 촬영 장비와 어울리는 다크 그레이 톤.
distinctive_features: 전면의 큰 near-spherical 'Infinity' 짐벌 볼 — 3렌즈(큰 Hasselblad 1 + 작은 텔레 2)가 구체 전면에 배열, 롤 360°/위 70° 틸트
매끈한 유선형 elongated 동체 + 전면 짐벌이 '잠자리/상어 머리'처럼 붙은 실루엣, 미드-다크 그레이 단색
4개 접이식 슬림 암(쿼드콥터), 펼침 폭(390.5)>길이(328.7)로 넓은 스탠스, 후방 암이 착륙 지지 겸함
긴 다리 없음 — 하부에 작은 착륙 발 + 어안 프로텍터 + 격자(grille)형 하부 질감
전방향 비전용 어안 렌즈 상단 3개·하단 3개(총 6), 상단 안테나 마스트/RTK 돔 없음
접이식 quick-release 프로펠러(2날 추정), 그레이/블랙
result.key_dimensions: 무게: 약 1063 g. 접힘(프롭 포함): 257.6×124.8×106.6 mm (L×W×H). 접힘(프롭 제외): 257.6×124.8×103.4 mm. 펼침(프롭 제외): 328.7×390.5×135.2 mm (L×W×H). ⚠️ 대각 wheelbase(mm)와 프롭 지름(mm)은 DJI 공식/1차 출처에서 확인하지 못함 — 명시 필요(펼침 폭 390.5mm에서 프롭 포함 대각을 근사만 가능). 프롭 부품번호 CP.MA.00000844.01.

result.body_shape: Compact elongated Mavic-3-style fuselage — a single smooth streamlined pod, wider/taller at the front than the tail. It is essentially a scaled Mavic 3 Enterprise body with a bulkier nose payload and an RTK bump on top. Not a box, not a flat plate; a rounded organic quadcopter body with the four arms projecting from the corners.
result.gimbal: Large FRONT-mounted 3-axis (tilt/roll/pan) gimbal, projecting forward from the nose (not belly-slung, not centered underneath). It is a multi-lens survey head with THREE camera lenses: 20MP 4/3-inch CMOS wide + 48MP 1/1.3-inch medium-tele (~70mm/3x) + 48MP 1/1.5-inch tele (~168mm/7x), plus a small laser rangefinder aperture. Prominent forward-hanging payload — the defining front feature. (4T variant adds a thermal camera + NIR spotlight pod; 4E is optical-only.) Gimbal mechanical range Tilt -140° to +50°.
result.arms: FOUR foldable arms (quad), slim Mavic-style. Front pair splays forward-outward, rear pair folds back; all fold inward/down against the body for transport. Arm color matches the gray body (not carbon/red-tipped). Motors at arm ends carry the props. Unfolded footprint 307.0 (L) × 387.5 (W) mm.
result.landing_gear: No separate tall landing legs — the landing feet are integrated into the underside of the FOLDING ARMS (feet on the arms, not on the body). This gives a wide leg span when unfolded and a very compact fold. Low ground clearance; short stubby feet at the arm/motor ends rather than long aching legs.
result.propeller: Two-blade props, quad = 4 props total, 10.8 inch diameter (model 1157F standard / 1154F low-noise). Slender modern DJI blade profile (gently swept/curved), no colored tips — same gray/black as body.
result.top_features: Distinctive TOP-MOUNTED RTK module — a raised bump/dome on the upper rear of the fuselage (the main visual difference vs a plain Mavic 3). Also an upward fisheye vision sensor. 8-antenna array is built into the airframe/arms (internal, not external whip masts). No external antenna mast rods sticking up.
result.color: DJI enterprise dark/medium gray (matte gray body and arms); black motors, gimbal and props.
distinctive_features: Large forward-projecting triple-lens survey gimbal on the nose (wide + medium-tele + tele + laser rangefinder aperture) — the dominant front feature
Raised RTK module bump/dome on the top-rear of the fuselage (key difference from a plain Mavic 3)
Four slim foldable Mavic-style arms with landing feet integrated INTO the arms (no separate tall legs), giving a wide unfolded leg span and compact fold
Six fisheye stereo obstacle-avoidance cameras (forward pair, rearward, upward, plus downward) dotted around the body, and a downward infrared/ToF sensor underneath
Elongated streamlined gray body, wider/taller at the nose than the tail
10.8-inch two-blade props, 4 arms/quad layout, 438.8 mm diagonal
result.key_dimensions: Diagonal wheelbase 438.8 mm. Propeller 10.8 in (~274 mm) diameter, models 1157F/1154F. Takeoff weight 1219 g (standard props) / 1229 g (low-noise). Folded 260.6×113.7×138.4 mm; Unfolded 307.0×387.5×149.5 mm (L×W×H, excl. propellers). All values from DJI official Matrice 4 Series specs page.

result.body_shape: Compact Mini-series foldable quadcopter. Elongated, flattened teardrop/wedge body: rounded-blunt nose that carries the gimbal, tapering thicker toward the rear where the battery seats. Smooth low-profile top shell with redesigned ventilation slots on the sides; slightly bulkier/taller than the Mini 4 Pro to house the 1-inch sensor gimbal. Four thin arms fold flush against the body when stowed (front arms swing out-forward, rear arms swing out-back-and-down).
result.gimbal: 3-axis mechanical gimbal at the FRONT NOSE, in a chin/underslung recess. Single large lens (1-inch 50MP CMOS) — one lens, not multi-lens. Housing is noticeably larger and sturdier than prior Minis to fit the 1-inch sensor. Wide mechanical travel (225° usable rotation): tilt approx -135° to +80°, roll approx -230° to +95°, pan approx -25° to +25° — so it can rotate up past horizontal and roll for true-vertical shooting. A small forward-facing LiDAR sensor and front fisheye obstacle cameras sit on the nose flanking/above the gimbal.
result.arms: 4 foldable arms (classic Mini foldable design, tighter tolerances / solid locking click on this gen). Front pair folds outward toward the front; rear pair folds outward and downward. Arms are slim and body-colored (dark grey, not carbon). Power on/off by folding/unfolding the right-rear arm. Arms are set at swept angles (not a simple X) typical of Mavic/Mini folding geometry, not fixed straight booms.
result.landing_gear: Simplified FORWARD LEGS ONLY. Short landing feet at the tips/underside of the two front arms act as the front stance; NO dedicated rear legs — the rear of the body/rear arm bases rest low, giving a more aerodynamic nose-down-ish stance and easier landing on uneven ground. Legs are short stubs, not long aircraft-style legs.
result.propeller: 4 propellers, quick-release, 2 blades each, gently swept (curved) tips. Diameter x pitch 6.0 x 2.8 inches (~152.4 mm diameter). Body/dark-grey colored blades, no colored tips.
result.top_features: No antenna mast, no RTK dome, no GPS bump on top — clean low top shell with ventilation slots. Dual transmission antennas are internal, routed in the rear arms/legs (O4+ transmission). Top is essentially featureless/smooth.
result.color: Dark grey (darker, more premium shade than the light-grey Mini 4 Pro).
distinctive_features: Front-nose single-lens 1-inch gimbal in a larger sturdier housing — the defining face of the drone
Forward-facing LiDAR sensor + front fisheye obstacle cameras on the nose (night/omnidirectional sensing)
Forward-legs-only landing gear (no rear legs) giving an aerodynamic stance
Slim body-colored foldable arms that fold flush (front-forward, rear-back-down), dark grey not carbon
Belly sensor cluster: dual downward binocular vision sensors + 3D infrared sensor on the underside
Smooth featureless dark-grey top shell with side ventilation slots (no antenna mast / no dome)
result.key_dimensions: Takeoff weight 249.9 g (±4 g). Folded (without propellers) 157 x 95 x 68 mm (LxWxH). Unfolded (with propellers) 255 x 181 x 91 mm (LxWxH). Propeller 6.0 x 2.8 in (~152.4 mm dia). Camera sensor: 1-inch CMOS, 50 MP. NOTE: DJI does not officially publish a diagonal/wheelbase figure for the Mini 5 Pro — not found in primary sources; estimate ~220-230 mm motor-to-motor diagonal from the unfolded footprint if needed, but this is NOT an official value.

result.body_shape: Classic Phantom "flying saucer" shell — a smooth, glossy, rounded streamlined body with a bulged dome top that tapers into four thick fixed arms integrated directly into the shell (arms are NOT separate booms and do NOT fold — they are molded extensions of the fuselage in an X layout). Predominantly white with a light grey/silver top shell. Two forward-facing obstacle-avoidance cameras sit in the "nose," and downward vision + ultrasonic sensors on the belly.
result.gimbal: 3-axis (pitch/roll/yaw) motorized gimbal, BELLY-mounted at the front-center underside (under the nose), hanging below the body between the two front landing legs. Single lens (one camera), 1-inch 20MP sensor, ~24mm-equivalent. Roughly a small spherical/oval housing ~a few cm across with the lens facing forward; yaw travel is deliberately limited so the fixed legs don't enter the frame. NOT a large multi-lens front gimbal like Mavic — it is a compact single-lens under-slung ball.
result.arms: Four FIXED (non-folding) arms molded as part of the white shell, arranged in an X (each ~45° off the fore-aft axis). Arms are thick and short, same white/grey color as the body (not carbon). Motor pods sit on top at each arm tip.
result.landing_gear: Fixed (non-retracting) arch/skid-type landing gear: two separate arched legs, one on each side, each spanning from the front to the rear of that side to form an inverted-U arch that the drone rests on. Legs are white and integrate the aircraft antennas (rear inner faces of the legs carry the patch-antenna covers). Gimbal hangs in the open gap at the front-center between the two front arch uprights.
result.propeller: Four 9455S low-noise quick-release propellers, 2 blades each, white, with gently swept/curved tips (low-noise profile), no colored tips. Diameter 9.4 in (~238.8 mm), pitch 5.5 in.
result.top_features: None significant — smooth domed top shell with cooling vents and status LEDs; NO top antenna mast, NO RTK dome, NO exposed GPS puck (GPS/compass are internal). Antennas are housed in the landing-gear legs, not on top.
result.color: White (glossy) body with light grey/silver top shell; white arms, legs, and propellers; dark gimbal camera.
distinctive_features: Curved glossy WHITE flying-saucer body with four FIXED (non-folding) arms molded into the shell in an X layout
Belly-mounted compact SINGLE-lens 3-axis gimbal ball hanging under the front-center nose (not a front-face multi-lens gimbal)
Two fixed arched skid landing legs (inverted-U), one per side, with antennas embedded in the rear legs
Smooth domed top with NO antenna mast / NO RTK dome — clean uninterrupted top surface
Two forward obstacle-avoidance cameras in the nose plus downward vision/ultrasonic sensors on the belly
White 2-blade 9455S low-noise props with swept tips, motor pods sitting on top of each arm tip
result.key_dimensions: Diagonal (wheelbase, without props): 350 mm. Unfolded dimensions L×W×H: 289.5 × 289.5 × 196 mm. Takeoff weight: 1375 g (incl. battery + props). Propeller: 9455S, 9.4 in diameter (~238.8 mm), 5.5 in pitch. (Diagonal 350 mm and weight 1375 g are official DJI figures; 289.5×289.5×196 mm and 9.4 in prop from DJI-derived spec listings.)

result.drone: DJI Spreading Wings S1000+ (professional AP octocopter, 8 rotors)
result.body_shape: Radial "spreading wings" octocopter, NOT a streamlined shell. Compact round/octagonal central hub (center frame ~337 mm diameter) built from two stacked circular carbon/glass plates with the electronics sandwiched between. Eight straight carbon-fiber tube arms radiate outward at even 45-degree spacing in the horizontal plane, each arm angled slightly downward (dihedral) from the hub. Overall footprint is flat and wide (1045 mm rotor-tip to rotor-tip), spider/starfish-like from above rather than a solid fuselage.
result.gimbal: No integrated camera. A low, minimalized damped gimbal-mounting bracket hangs from the BELLY (underside center) of the hub on rubber vibration dampers; it accepts a separate Zenmuse gimbal (e.g. Z15) so the camera sits centrally beneath the aircraft, low enough to clear a full 360-degree view. Lens count depends on the mounted Zenmuse (typically a single large camera). Model as a downward damping plate + optional single-lens gimbal ball below center.
result.arms: 8 arms, foldable (fold DOWN/in for transport, lifted up and locked for flight). Thin round carbon-fiber tubes ~386 mm long, black. Each hinges at the hub with a bright RED locking knob/clip at the root. Arms spaced at 45 degrees (octagonal radial layout), tilted slightly downward. A motor (4114-pro, 41x14 mm stator, silver/black can with red cooling-fan accents) sits at the outboard tip of each arm, propeller mounted on top of the motor. Body/arms are black carbon; red is the accent color (locks, front-arm markers).
result.landing_gear: Retractable carbon-fiber landing gear: two large inverted-U / arched legs (one front, one rear) that hang well below the hub, with wide horizontal skid feet. Servo-driven "Intelligent Landing Gear" swings the legs UP out of the camera's view in flight and lowers them for landing. Envelope 460 mm (L) x 511 mm (W) x 305 mm (H). Long, tall, arched — a defining silhouette feature.
result.propeller: 8 propellers, model 1552 (and reverse 1552R), 15 x 5.2 inch (15-inch / ~381 mm diameter), 2-bladed, foldable, black high-performance engineered plastic. Blades are broad and paddle-like. Standard blades are all black (the official spec does not list red propeller tips; red on the airframe is the arm locks and front-arm markers, not the prop tips). One rotor spins on top of each arm-tip motor.
result.top_features: GPS module/compass mounted on top of the center frame on a raised bracket/short mast (lifted above the power board to avoid interference). Top of hub is the flat upper circular plate with the GPS puck on its stalk. No large antenna array.
result.color: Matte black (carbon-fiber tubes and plates) with red accents (red arm-lock knobs/clips, red front-arm identifiers); metallic motor cans.
distinctive_features: 8 straight carbon-fiber arms in a flat radial 45-degree spider layout, slightly drooped (dihedral), NOT a molded body
Foldable arms that stow downward, with a bright RED locking knob/clip at each arm root — the signature red-on-black look
Retractable arched landing gear: two tall inverted-U carbon legs that motor UP in flight and down to land
Belly-mounted low damped gimbal cradle hanging from center underside (Zenmuse camera mounts here)
Small round/octagonal twin-plate central hub with a GPS puck on a short mast on top
Motor at each arm tip carrying a black 15-inch (1552) foldable 2-blade prop on top
result.key_dimensions: Diagonal wheelbase (rotor-tip to rotor-tip): 1045 mm. Arm length: 386 mm each. Center frame diameter: 337 mm. Propeller: 1552 = 15 x 5.2 inch (15 in / ~381 mm diameter). Landing gear envelope: 460 x 511 x 305 mm (LxWxH). Total aircraft weight: 4.4 kg; recommended takeoff weight 6.0–11.0 kg. Motor 4114-pro (stator 41x14 mm, 400 rpm/V, 500 W max). Per-arm weight 325 g (incl. motor/ESC/prop); center frame 1520 g. No single official overall unfolded LxWxH published — footprint ~1045 mm diameter across props; folded dimensions not given in DJI spec.
